input.field_presence: every listed field is required; nullable fields MUST be present with null
input.command_order: array order; at values MUST be nondecreasing; equal at values retain array order
input.logical_time: non-negative safe integer milliseconds supplied by each command

semantics.initial_attempt: create makes attempt 1 pending with owner_epoch 0 and eligible_at equal to create.at
semantics.acquire: only the current eligible pending attempt is leaseable; success increments owner_epoch and makes it running
semantics.lease_fence: renew, settle, and settle_with_retry require the exact current owner_id and owner_epoch while at is strictly less than lease_until
semantics.renewal: renew keeps owner_epoch unchanged, sets lease_until to at plus lease_ms, and emits lease_acquired
semantics.expiry_boundary: expire is accepted exactly when at is greater than or equal to lease_until
semantics.expiry_retry: expiry first emits lease_expired; if attempts remain it creates a distinct pending attempt and then emits attempt_retried
semantics.expiry_final: expiry first emits lease_expired; at the attempt cap the same attempt becomes failed and attempt_failed follows
semantics.failure_retry: settle_with_retry accepts only failure; it emits attempt_failed, then creates a distinct pending attempt and emits attempt_retried when attempts remain
semantics.plain_failure: settle failure is terminal even when attempts remain
semantics.cancel: cancel is unfenced, terminal, and absorbing once applied; later commands are rejected
semantics.retry_overflow: if retry eligibility cannot be represented as a safe integer, reject with RETRY_TIME_OVERFLOW before changing attempt state or appending an event
semantics.retry_epoch: creating a retry increments owner_epoch; acquiring that retry increments it again
semantics.rejection: a rejected command changes no state and appends no event

rejection_precedence: MALFORMED_COMMAND for the generic command envelope
MALFORMED_COMMAND for the selected known operation
rejection_algorithm: validate the trace shape before profile; for each command validate op and at, reject an unknown op, validate every required field for the selected known operation, then evaluate policy and lifecycle state in the listed order

canonical_json.object_keys: lexicographic order by Unicode code point
canonical_json.numbers: safe integers only; floats, negative zero, and non-finite values are rejected
canonical_json.strings: valid Unicode scalar values only; lone surrogates are rejected

invariants: exactly one current attempt exists after create
attempt numbers are contiguous and never exceed max_attempts
at most one attempt is running and it is current
owner_epoch is monotonic and the work epoch equals the current attempt epoch
cancel wins over every command applied after it
event seq values are contiguous and event order is normative
every retry is a distinct attempt
invalid commands preserve the exact pre-command state digest
non_claims: no live process or PID authority
no authentication, authorization, credentials, or trust roots
